title: Salesman

{{Infobox/Character |location = [[Village]] |location_page_description = Advertises the Hypixel store. |x=-9.5 |y=71 |z=-15.5 }} The '''Salesman''' is an [[NPC]] located in the {{zone|village}}. During various seasonal events on Hypixel, Salesman will get replaced with NPCs that will award the player [[Reward Bundles]] with festive cosmetics. __TOC__ == Seasonal Appearance, Interface == Salesman without a Seasonal Appearance only has dialogue when clicked on. Salesman with a Seasonal Appearance opens a [[Reward Bundles]] interface when clicked on. |-|Easter= [[File:Bunny Man.png|thumb|x200px|The Bunny Man NPC]] During April to May, the Seasonal Appearance of Salesman is {{NPCSprite|Bunny Man}}. From Bunny Man, ranked players can redeem various rewards. A player's Hypixel Rank determines the tier of rewards received.
The items are purely cosmetic. {{/UI|easter}} |-|Summer= [[File:Summer Sloth.png|thumb|x200px|The Summer Sloth NPC]] During June to August, the Seasonal Appearance of Salesman is {{NPCSprite|Summer Sloth}}. From Summer Sloth, ranked players can redeem various rewards. A player's Hypixel Rank determines the tier of rewards received.
The items are purely cosmetic. {{/UI|summer}} |-|Halloween= [[File:Spooky Man.png|thumb|x200px|The Spooky Man NPC]] During October, the Seasonal Appearance of Salesman is {{NPCSprite|Spooky Man}}. From Spooky Man, ranked players can redeem various rewards. A player's Hypixel Rank determines the tier of rewards received.
The items are purely cosmetic. {{/UI|spooky}} |-|Holidays= [[File:Gingerbread Man.png|thumb|x200px|The Gingerbread Man NPC]] During December, the Seasonal Appearance of Salesman is {{NPCSprite|Gingerbread Man}}. From Gingerbread Man, ranked players can redeem various rewards. A player's Hypixel Rank determines the tier of rewards received.
The items are purely cosmetic. {{/UI|holidays}} == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable" !colspan=2|Salesman Appearance |- !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | None |{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &bSalesman&f: Thank you for supporting the server and allowing us to maintain SkyBlock! &e[NPC] &bSalesman&f: If you want to support us, head over to the Hypixel Store at &bstore.hypixel.net}} |- !colspan=2|Seasonal Appearance |- !Condition !Dialogue |- | class="ct" | Claiming a Bundle |{{Dialogue|&aYou claimed the [] Bundle! &eYay!}} |- | class="ct" | Already Claimed Bundle |{{Dialogue|&cAlready claimed!}} |- | class="ct" | Claiming a Bundle that Requires Higher Rank |{{Dialogue|&cRequires []}} |} == Gallery == Bunny Man.png|Bunny Man Summer Sloth.png|Summer Sloth Summer Man.png|Summer Man Spooky Man.png|Spooky Man Gingerbread Man.png|Gingerbread Man == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/Jan 30|Moved '''Salesman''' from {{Coords|7|70|-85}} to {{Coords|-9.5|71|-15.5}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} |beta= {{History|0.7|[[File:Salesman.png|26px]] Added '''Salesman'''.}} {{History|unknown;June 2020|[[File:Salesman.png|26px]] Changed the Seasonal Appearance in Summer from '''Summer Man''' to '''Summer Sloth'''.}} {{History|0.24.2|Moved '''Salesman''' from {{Coords|7|70|-85}} to {{Coords|-9.5|71|-15.5}}, due to the redesign of the [[Hub Island]].}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}}
